briefing: Market is neutral today (NASDAQ +0.6%, S&P 500 +0.5%) with no strong risk-on signal, so we're not forcing full deployment of all three open slots. We're adding two moderate-conviction momentum names (NN, VSAT) with confirmed MACD/RSI/SMA-20 setups to put some of the idle cash to work while keeping a buffer and letting existing winners run.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like a rising MACD, a healthy RSI, and price above its moving average — to agree before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. It helps avoid chasing false breakouts, especially on quiet, neutral market days like today.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前，等待多個技術指標（例如MACD上升、RSI處於健康區間、股價高於移動平均線）同時發出一致訊號，而不是只靠單一信號行動。這有助避免在今日這種平靜、中性的市況下，追逐虛假的突破。

market_education.summary_en: Today's modest NASDAQ (+0.6%) and S&P 500 (+0.5%) gains reflect a broadly calm, low-volatility session without a major catalyst pushing stocks sharply in either direction. In the absence of strong risk-on conviction signals like a volume surge, the market is best read as consolidating rather than breaking out. No specific news headlines were available in today's data feed to cite.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納指(+0.6%)及標普500(+0.5%)只錄得溫和升幅，反映市況大致平靜，未見明顯重大消息刺激股價大幅波動。在缺乏成交量激增等強烈「風險偏好」信號的情況下，現時市場較像在整固而非突破。今日數據中未提供具體新聞標題可供引用。
